scope: Solver includes reference rebuild unless explicit cache mode; API includes seven outputs; input file read, construction, save excluded. Host buffers pinned outside timing. RSS through measured solves includes input loading and initialization. Device bytes are explicit allocations, not NVML/physical peak.

sampled_memory.scope: 25ms sampled peaks are lower bounds. Adapter profiles: formal only. CLI profiles: whole lifetime including constructor. System RAM includes background/cache. Unified DRAM metrics overlap; do not sum.
